description: This file defines the AnimatedTrail class for managing animated laser pointer trails in an SVG context, including methods for starting, stopping, updating, and rendering trails, as well as handling animation frames.

classes.name: AnimatedTrail
classes.description: Class implementing animated laser pointer trails with SVG rendering and animation control.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and begins the trail rendering within an optional SVG container.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the trail rendering and removes SVG elements.

methods.name: startPath
methods.description: Begins a new trail path at specified coordinates.

methods.name: addPointToPath
methods.description: Adds a point to the current trail path.

methods.name: endPath
methods.description: Ends the current trail path and stores it.

methods.name: onFrame
methods.description: Handles animation frame updates, rendering trails.

methods.name: drawTrail
methods.description: Generates SVG path data from a trail and application state.
